refereeReport.title: Upload incident report
refereeReport.hint: The referees are required to submit an incident report for this game. Referees can upload the completed report form here (PDF, PNG or JPEG, max. 5 MB).

forwardedTo.vsk: It is forwarded automatically to the responsible disciplinary committee (VSK).
forwardedTo.sbk: It is forwarded automatically to the responsible game operations office (SBK).
forwardedTo.vsk_and_sbk: It is forwarded automatically to the responsible disciplinary committee (VSK) and game operations office (SBK).

uploaded.vsk: {{ filename }} was uploaded and forwarded to the VSK.
uploaded.sbk: {{ filename }} was uploaded and forwarded to the SBK.
uploaded.vsk_and_sbk: {{ filename }} was uploaded and forwarded to the VSK and the SBK.

refereeReport.tooLarge: The file must not exceed 5 MB.
